svg.title: VoidHub UI
svg.desc: VoidHub design reference showing the Main tab at 760 pixels and open search results at the 480-pixel minimum window width. This mockup is not a Roblox screenshot.

g.text: Black surfaces, silver details, and motion that settles quickly.
Useful feedback, when you need it.
Useful feedback, when you need it.
A persistent marker; the next page eases in once.
One 480 ms edge sheen, then still chrome.
Panels stack; search matches stay in reach.
DESIGN REFERENCE · VOIDHUB 1.2 · NOT ROBLOX CLIENT CAPTURE
